# Release platform history

These four-part delivery versions track source changes independently of the
package SemVer in `VERSION` and the plugin manifests. This history begins with
the platform convention; earlier three-part commit titles are not rewritten.
The first entry advances the existing 0.2.0 product baseline for compatible
features. Recording an entry does not publish a package or authorize a push.

## 1.2.1.0 - 2026-10-27

Summary: Keep campaign drafts and generated promotional artwork local by
ignoring campaign directories. Product package SemVer remains 0.3.0.

Threat impact: Reduce accidental publication of campaign drafts and creative
working files. Product evidence-handling behavior is unchanged.

Sovereignty impact: Campaign files remain available locally without adding
tracking, publication automation or a runtime service.

Validation: Ignore rules, exact commit scope and distribution checks are
recorded locally. No campaign publication or deployment was performed.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 1.2.0.0 - 2026-10-26

Summary: Add exact citation preparation, visible report limitations and portable restore guidance.
Package SemVer remains 0.3.0 with these additions recorded as Unreleased.

Threat impact: Preserve source bytes, bounded excerpts and analysis hashes.
Distinguish matching text from semantic support and compatible hypotheses.

Sovereignty impact: All helpers remain offline and standard-library-only.
No provider, collection, transmission or automatic installation is added.

Validation: Synthetic regression and package checks are recorded locally.
Further model trials and native client compatibility remain unverified.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 1.1.1.0 - 2026-10-26

Summary: Correct local text comparison prerequisites and distinguish media
metadata examination from geolocation with an explicit objective. Identify
optional routed methods and actions consistently through the CLI and MCP.
Package SemVer remains 0.3.0 with these corrections recorded as Unreleased.

Threat impact: Keep missing objectives, inputs and prerequisites visible.
Assignments and declared completion never establish execution or authenticity.
Preserve bounded read-only planning and existing case privacy controls.

Sovereignty impact: Keep planning offline and standard-library-only with no
model calls, collection, provider setup or automatic tool execution.

Validation: Synthetic planner, CLI, MCP and distribution checks are recorded
with their observed scope in the local verification log.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 1.1.0.0 - 2026-10-26

Summary: Add bounded offline Wayback CDX selection, BODACC publication histories
by SIREN and SRT/WebVTT cue imports. Preserve source indexes and check complete
transcript interval citations. Include a synthetic report and export/restore demo.
Package SemVer remains 0.3.0 with these additions recorded as Unreleased.

Threat impact: Reject ambiguous JSON, malformed dates, unsafe URL schemes,
invalid cue intervals and oversized inputs. Preserve originals and bind citations
to analysis hashes without inferring page contents, ownership or spoken words.

Sovereignty impact: Keep all imports offline and standard-library-only. Add no
provider, remote MCP, network collection, transcription or installation.

Validation: Synthetic parser, citation, CLI and distribution checks are recorded
in the local verification log with their observed scope.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 1.0.0.0 - 2026-10-25

Summary: Add coherent case exports, strict CSV intake, operation-scoped integrity
and citation caches, transactional selected skill installation, phased planning,
and schema 4 hypotheses, tests, assertion origins and append-only corrections.
Extend optional MCP with methods, output contracts and bounded cancellation.
Support qualified PDF page citations, derived comparisons and selected Codex
event exports. Package SemVer is 0.3.0, distinct from this delivery version.

Threat impact: Reject mixed export states and ambiguous records. Retain bounded
read-only analysis, integrity checks, exact-path ownership and modified-file
refusal. Schema 4 requires a verified-copy upgrade for new record semantics.

Sovereignty impact: Keep the distributed runtime standard-library-only and
offline. Enable no provider, telemetry, collection, installation or global
client configuration automatically. Host specialization remains advisory.

Validation: Synthetic regression, isolated distribution, official MCP SDK and
native Windows checks are recorded with their exact snapshots and limitations.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 0.3.0.0 - 2026-10-18

Summary: Add prioritized case review and a count-only MCP summary, refresh the
private HTML review dashboard, and index event citations for faster selection.
Introduce platform delivery histories and the signed commit convention.

Threat impact: Keep review read-only, restrict MCP output to aggregate counters,
detect persistent journal changes, and preserve bounded parsing, escaping and CSP.

Sovereignty impact: Keep the standard-library runtime offline and all evidence
and generated reports local; add no provider, telemetry or external dependency.

Validation: 192 local tests passed; generated skills and archives were checked.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.
